description: Create a single-use Flomixy link (valid about 10 minutes) where the user uploads one image or video from their device. Give the link to the user and tell them it expires at `expiresAt`. After they upload, call list_media to get the new file url and pass it in `mediaUrls`. Clients with shell access can skip the user: POST the file as multipart field `file` to `uploadEndpoint` (the `curl` example; answers {id,url,mediaType}), no base64 and no 10 MB inline limit. The link is single-use: one link per file, so 8 slides need 8 calls. Needs the MEDIA_WRITE scope.
name: create_upload_link
title: Create media upload link
